program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (fill-one-row out r color)
      (let ((cols-hit (map second (filter-cells g (lambda (rr c v) (and (= rr r) (= v color)))))))
        (if (< (length cols-hit) 2)
            out
            (for/fold ([acc out]) ([c (in-range (apply min cols-hit) (+ (apply max cols-hit) 1))])
              (set-cell acc r c color)))))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([r (in-range (rows g))])
      (for/fold ([acc out]) ([color (in-list (remove-duplicates (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (row g r))))])
        (fill-one-row acc r color)))))
